## Core Engineering & Commercial Competencies
1. **Website Engineering & Development:**
   - Frameworks: Next.js 14 (App Router, Server Components, SSR/SSG), React 18, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Node.js.
   - Deliverables: High-performance business websites, academic journals, institutional portals, and custom web applications.
2. **E-commerce & Multi-Channel Marketplace Operations:**
   - Marketplace Platforms: Amazon Seller Central, Flipkart Marketplace, Meesho Supplier Panel.
   - Services: Catalog architecture, SKU taxonomy standardization, high-converting product descriptions, bullet points, and search keyword optimization.
3. **Technical SEO & Core Web Vitals:**
   - Architecture: Schema.org structured data (JSON-LD), XML sitemaps, robots.txt directives, semantic HTML5, sub-second LCP optimization, zero layout shifts (CLS < 0.1).
4. **Data Analytics, NLP & Automation:**
   - Tooling: Python (Pandas, Scikit-learn, Fast-API), natural language processing (NLP sentiment analysis), automated reporting scripts.

## Verified Projects & Case Studies
- **Paras Metal (`/projects/paras-metal`):** Multi-channel retail catalog architecture and product listing readiness across Amazon India, Flipkart, and Meesho for an artisanal brass handicraft manufacturer.
- **Sanmati Journal (`/projects/sanmati-journal`):** Digital publishing platform for an international peer-reviewed multidisciplinary academic research journal (ISSN 3108-1819 & CrossRef DOI).
- **Dr. Sarvepalli Radhakrishnan College (`/projects/dsr-college`):** Official institutional web portal (dsr.college) for a recognized teacher education college in Nalanda, Bihar (NCTE disclosures, B.Ed. and D.El.Ed. admissions prospectus).
- **Pravaah UPSC (`/projects/pravaah-upsc`):** Distraction-free digital learning and mentorship platform for civil services aspirants, featuring structured GS subject modules and PYQ archives.
- **Jambudweep Cultural Platform (`/projects/jambudweep`):** Heritage pilgrim web portal for the historical Hastinapur center, featuring architectural archives, facility guides, and mobile-friendly visitor information.
